propositions: A bare git repository created with `git init --bare` and pushed to runs `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` as a background process that outlives the push, causing concurrent mutation of the object database while subsequent `shutil.copytree` operations walk the directory tree.
The copytree failure manifests not only as `objects/maintenance.lock` disappearing, but more broadly as loose-object fanout directories vanishing mid-walk as maintenance repacks them into packfiles.

Setting `receive.autogc=false`, `gc.autoDetach=false`, and `maintenance.autoDetach=false` on a fixture bare remote before any operations pins the upkeep posture and prevents background maintenance from running, eliminating the race entirely rather than narrowing its window.
The test fixture must apply upkeep pins immediately after bare repository initialization, before any pushes, to guarantee no concurrent mutators exist when subsequent copy operations begin.

A guard assertion that inspects git's process trace (via GIT_TRACE2_EVENT) to verify no `git maintenance run` child carries `--detach` can detect the presence of background maintenance without relying on timing assumptions.
The fix removes the concurrent mutator as a structural property of the fixture rather than tolerating the race through retries, sleeps, timing bounds, or ignore predicates.
